Lead researcher

interpretation and recommendations

Field researcher
[Person]
collects survey and walk data,
codes open answers, writes notes

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Reviewing colleague
[Person]
checks every claim before
the report goes out

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Lab tech lead
[Person]
installs the tool, chooses models,
runs the experiments

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
InnoBeweegLab reporting tool
[Software system]
turns survey, expert-walk, map and demographic data into a
traceable draft Wijkscan report: every claim cites evidence,
every evidence item cites source cells; nothing is exported
until a researcher has approved every claim

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Research data files
[External · on the laptop]
Excel sheets, QGIS map PNGs,
Word demographics, RIVM rules PDF

span.p:
Ollama model server
[External · same laptop]
runs the local language and
vision models

Azure OpenAI or Mistral; only for
experiment E6, never resident free text
